say:1:1423464001:1.text: Everyone, Lady Celestine has made a generous contribution to the cause!
say:1:1423464001:1.source_cn: 各位，莱索兰女士为本次募捐贡献了一份珍贵的善心！

say:2:1423464002:1.text: ... Well, you all know I've always cared deeply about the commoners. Thank you, Captain Indris, for this chance to help...
say:2:1423464002:1.source_cn: ……大家都知道的，我一直十分关注平民的生活，感谢因度厄...

say:3:1423464003:1.text: And what about you, ladies and gentlemen? Care to join in?
say:3:1423464003:1.source_cn: 这几位先生和女士，也对义捐感兴趣吗？

say:5:1423464004:1.text: If Celestine is doing it... sure, why not?
say:5:1423464004:1.source_cn: 连莱索兰都……那我也捐点吧。

say:6:1423464005:1.text: Fine, fine, you dragged me all the way here. I might as well donate!
say:6:1423464005:1.source_cn: 既然你们都把我弄过来了……我捐还不行嘛！

say:8:1423464006:1.text: Indris really knows how to work a crowd... I wonder where he picked that up from.
say:8:1423464006:1.source_cn: 因度厄还真是手段老练啊！这做事的风格，跟谁学的呢……

say:9:1423464007:1.text: Probably all the hard jobs Ravion's been assigning lately. Compared to those, organizing a fundraiser is a breeze.
say:9:1423464007:1.source_cn: 是因为工作的磨砺吧，最近沙利叶分给了我不少困难的工作，...

say:10:1423464008:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, none of this would've worked out so well without you.
say:10:1423464008:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, none of this would've worked out so well without you.
say:10:1423464008:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, none of this would've worked out so well without you.

say:11:1423464009:1.text: I know Ravion sent you. Allow me to thank you, on behalf of both of us.
say:11:1423464009:1.source_cn: 我知道你们是受沙利叶所托，我代他向你们致以我们两人的谢意。
